title: Fix 3 buggy Rust string utility functions
description: Greenfield Rust dirty scenario: a string-utils library has 3 broken implementations. Fix reverse, is_palindrome, and capitalize so all tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 buggy functions in src/lib.rs so all tests pass.

  pub fn reverse(s: &str) -> String
    — return the characters of s in reverse order

  pub fn is_palindrome(s: &str) -> bool
    — return true if s reads the same forwards and backwards

  pub fn capitalize(s: &str) -> String
    — return s with only the first character uppercased, the rest unchanged

Do not modify the test functions.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: reverse returns characters in reverse order
is_palindrome returns true for palindromes, false otherwise
capitalize uppercases only the first character
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
